snippet.title: Altered Alma - PS5 Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Altered Alma is a cyberpunk Metroidvania with RPG and dating-sim elements, set in Neo Barcelona. You play Jack, who upgrades a ship, recruits a crew and takes on the city's gangs, in a story written by Antony Johnston and Emma Beeby. From 2Awesome Studio and CRITICAL REFLEX.
